title: alchemilla vulgaris var. semisecta
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris var. semisecta, commonly known as Lady's Mantle, is a perennial herb belonging to the Rosaceae family, characterized by its lobed, toothed leaves and clusters of small, greenish-yellow flowers. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in wound healing, reducing menstrual cramps, and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Lady's Mantle are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the body, making it useful in treating anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoid saponins, which contribute to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities.
